title: SCHC fragmentation vectors need regeneration
description:
The recovery and window_transition vectors in schc_fragmentation.json have incorrect ACK byte formats:
- ACK bytes are 11 bytes but should be max 10 bytes (rule_id + 9 bytes for W+C+bitmap+padding)
- The implementation correctly validates this per RFC 8724 WINDOW_SIZE=63

Also, the over_profile_capacity vector expects a 126-fragment limit that isn't implemented in FragmentSender (only checks payload > receiver_limit).

Tests are currently skipped with ponytail comments. Proper fix requires regenerating vectors with correct bitmap encoding.
